title: Oracle of the Burnt Reel
description: A pale woman with white face paint and purple eyes sits in a crumbling, fiery archway wearing an ornate yellow and purple gown. She rests beside a giant vintage film reel while film strips, an open film case labeled 'FEATURE REEL 215 - ORACLE', and scattered tarot cards lie on the ground. Behind her, a broken wall reveals a scorched apocalyptic landscape under spotlights.
prompt: A mystical woman with white face paint and striking purple eyes sits in a decaying stone archway with flames and cracks, wearing an ornate vintage yellow and purple gown. A giant old film reel rests beside her as film strips spill across the floor along with an open film case labeled FEATURE REEL 215 - ORACLE and scattered tarot cards. Through the broken archway is a fiery apocalyptic wasteland under dramatic spotlights, dark moody atmosphere, highly detailed symbolic painting
